read_locations.finding: Distrib requires both quantified distributive laws; semiring/ring/commutative ring names bundle stated obligations.
read_locations.book_obligation: NP/NL/SP/SR must prove these cut operations separately before using the structure names; full distributivity is only reached in B2.28.

read_locations.finding: Within an already assumed NonUnitalNonAssocRing, neg_mul and mul_neg are derived using distributivity; mul_sub/add_sub identities then follow.
read_locations.book_obligation: This dependency cannot be imported for SP2: our signs are first verified directly from the cut sign definition; full distributivity is later proved using these signs. Only after SR2 may the difference identities be used.

read_locations.finding: Nonnegative factors preserve weak order; positive factors preserve strict order. An algebraic semiring and ordered addition are prior assumptions.
read_locations.book_obligation: Weak monotonicity first follows directly from P witnesses; strict monotonicity NL4 uses already proved nonnegative distributivity and D=B⊖A>0.

read_locations.finding: IsOrderedRing.of_mul_nonneg and IsStrictOrderedRing.of_mul_pos derive order multiplication from positivity of a difference product, assuming Ring.
read_locations.book_obligation: Use as dependency comparison. The actual book SR3 calculation must explicitly invoke earlier SR2 distribution and DG4 difference order; no circular use of an abstract ring before SR2.

read_locations.finding: Basic ordered-ring lemmas start with existing algebra and order assumptions; IsSquare.nonneg assumes Semiring, LinearOrder and monotone multiplication.
read_locations.book_obligation: Reviewed only to reject it as a construction source or proof of missing cut roots. No theorem from this file is needed by the four planned units.

read_locations.finding: Midpoint inequalities under existing ordered-field/semifield assumptions.
read_locations.book_obligation: Apply only to the established rational numbers. Explicit rational midpoint witnesses prove P closure, identity, rational compatibility and NL association; no real completeness used.

read_locations.finding: Part I §VI gives addition and says other elementary operations can be defined; distributivity is discussed through continuity rather than supplying this plan’s modern strict one-sided cut proof.
read_locations.book_obligation: Historical attribution only. Do not attribute our P formula, zero branch, common witness, signed distributivity or rational reciprocal proof to an exact passage not found. These are independent book derivations.

independent_derivations: P positive rational witnesses with explicit negative branch
four cut closure checks including zero
identity rational midpoint witnesses and principal-cut product
nested triple product witnesses and nonnegative distributivity with common maximum witness
signed product and full mixed-sign distributivity from ordered additive group
positive reciprocal cut future route, not claimed proved
